title: Customer Base & Growth
note: Computed by checks_dashboards_demo.py from the frozen .psv rows, with the same definitions truths.out uses. Each value carries the SQL it came from; Phase B2 holds every widget to these numbers.

kpis.label: Customers
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.customers c WHERE true

kpis.label: New in the last 30 days
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.customers c WHERE true AND c.signup_date > DATE '2026-09-30' - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND c.signup_date <= DATE '2026-09-30'

kpis.label: Repeat buyers %
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(CASE WHEN n > 1 THEN 1 END) / count(*), 2) FROM (SELECT c.customer_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status <> 'cancelled') AS n FROM dash_demo.customers c WHERE true)

kpis.label: Largest segment
kpis.sql: SELECT c.segment FROM dash_demo.customers c WHERE true GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

kpis.label: Customers
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.customers c WHERE true AND c.segment = 'Enterprise'

kpis.label: New in the last 30 days
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.customers c WHERE true AND c.segment = 'Enterprise' AND c.signup_date > DATE '2026-09-30' - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND c.signup_date <= DATE '2026-09-30'

kpis.label: Repeat buyers %
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(CASE WHEN n > 1 THEN 1 END) / count(*), 2) FROM (SELECT c.customer_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status <> 'cancelled') AS n FROM dash_demo.customers c WHERE true AND c.segment = 'Enterprise')

kpis.label: Largest segment
kpis.sql: SELECT c.segment FROM dash_demo.customers c WHERE true AND c.segment = 'Enterprise' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

kpis.label: Customers
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.customers c WHERE true AND c.acquisition_channel IN ('referral')

kpis.label: New in the last 30 days
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.customers c WHERE true AND c.acquisition_channel IN ('referral') AND c.signup_date > DATE '2026-09-30' - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND c.signup_date <= DATE '2026-09-30'

kpis.label: Repeat buyers %
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(CASE WHEN n > 1 THEN 1 END) / count(*), 2) FROM (SELECT c.customer_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status <> 'cancelled') AS n FROM dash_demo.customers c WHERE true AND c.acquisition_channel IN ('referral'))

kpis.label: Largest segment
kpis.sql: SELECT c.segment FROM dash_demo.customers c WHERE true AND c.acquisition_channel IN ('referral') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

density.bucket: month x channel, partner and email folded into Other
density.rule: each series of a split line
density.sql: SELECT min(n) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM dash_demo.customers c WHERE true AND c.signup_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', c.signup_date), CASE WHEN c.acquisition_channel IN ('partner', 'email') THEN 'Other' ELSE c.acquisition_channel END)

density.rule: each series of a split or filtered line
density.sql: SELECT min(n) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM dash_demo.customers c WHERE true AND c.segment = 'Enterprise' AND c.signup_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', c.signup_date))

density.rule: each series of a split or filtered line
density.sql: SELECT min(n) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM dash_demo.customers c WHERE true AND c.acquisition_channel IN ('referral') AND c.signup_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', c.signup_date))
